trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    def crop(g):
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
        if not pts: return []
        a,b=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
        x,y=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        return [row[x:y+1] for row in g[a:b+1]]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==8 for r in range(h))]
    if cols:
        c=cols[0]
        a=crop([row[:c] for row in grid]); b=crop([row[cols[-1]+1:] for row in grid])
        if not a:return b
        if not b:return a
        return [(a[r] if r<len(a) else [0]*len(a[0]))+(b[r] if r<len(b) else [0]*len(b[0])) for r in range(max(len(a),len(b)))]
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==8 for v in grid[r])]
    if rows:return crop(grid[:rows[0]])+crop(grid[rows[-1]+1:])
    return crop([[0 if v==8 else v for v in row] for row in grid])
